The sister of the husband was not ever residing in the matrimonial home but she has also been roped in.

There is a false allegation of the Complainant being forced to undergo abortion.
The FIR is the blatant misuse of process of law and may be quashed.

sentences.text: 5. On the specific query, it has admitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that the FIR has been registered only on 08.10.2025 and the investigations are still on going.
6. This is the initial stage where the matter is being investigated and all the allegations are under investigations to ascertain the truth of veracity of the same.
This Court cannot sit as a Trial Court to ascertain the genuineness or the falsity of the investigations.
7. The present quashing Petition is not only pre-mature but is in fact to pre-empt any coercive action being taken against the Petitioners.
8. There is no merit in the present Petition, which is hereby dismissed.
9. The Petition is disposed of accordingly.
Pending Application, if any, also stands disposed of.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J DECEMBER 24, 2025/RS
